page_title: ProBoard - Project Management App - App Store

sources.entry: ProBoard - Use one board to manage all your project information efficiently.[![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748314346?platform=mac)

summary.name: ProBoard
summary.one_liner: ProBoard is a Mac project management app that consolidates tasks, notes, links, and images for a project into a single unified board.
use_cases: Consolidating project tasks, notes, and links in one place
Organizing images and reference material for a project
Getting a structured overview of ongoing work
summary.what_it_does: ["Puts tasks, notes, links, images, and other project resources onto a single unified board.", "Includes a To do board where new to-dos can be added quickly by pressing Enter.", "Has an Image module with a hover menu, per the release notes for version 1.6.1.", "Aims to give a complete, structured overview of a user's work to reduce fragmented information.", "The page gives no further detail on features, pricing, or workflows."]
notable: Single board combining tasks, notes, links, and images
Quick to-do entry by pressing Enter in the To do board
Developer states it does not collect any data from the app
caveats: The App Store page has no ratings or reviews yet, so user feedback is unavailable
Accessibility features have not been indicated by the developer
Pricing is not stated on the page
